expected_results.online: PrinterStatus Normal or Idle, WorkOffline false

remediation.label: ask Windows to bring the printer back online
remediation.user_impact: This only clears the 'use printer offline' flag. It will not delete files.

plain_language.problem: Windows still has the printer on the list, but it thinks the printer is switched off or disconnected.
plain_language.solution: I can ask Windows to treat the printer as online again. If the printer itself is unplugged or off, you'll still need to power it on.
